title: Everyday Pay Card Statement Cap by Shopper Standing, Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
# Cartwise Shopper Payouts: statement cap schedule for high-standing shoppers

The cap a statement payment on an Everyday Pay Card plan is paid under depends on the shopper's level and recent work. The level is the shopper level shown on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record; the recent work is the count of batch base-pay entries booked on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Batches in the last month.

**Rule.** A shopper at Full-Service Shopper Diamond level with 20 or more batch base-pay entries in the last month is paid under 1.5 times the monthly cashback cap of the card plan. A shopper at Full-Service Shopper Platinum level with 15 or more batch base-pay entries in the last month is paid under 1.25 times that cap. Any other shopper is paid under the monthly cashback cap of the card plan. A raised cap is rounded to the cent.

"The last month" counts the entries booked fewer than one whole month before the day of the payment.

## Schedule

| Shopper level | Batch base-pay entries in the last month | Cap paid under |
|---|---|---|
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 20 or more | 1.5 times the card plan's monthly cashback cap, rounded to the cent |
| Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 19 or fewer | the card plan's monthly cashback cap |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 15 or more | 1.25 times the card plan's monthly cashback cap, rounded to the cent |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 14 or fewer | the card plan's monthly cashback cap |
| Any other level | any number | the card plan's monthly cashback cap |

Each raised cap is tied to one level only: a Diamond shopper with 15 to 19 base-pay entries does not take the Platinum multiple, and a Platinum shopper with 20 or more entries takes 1.25, never 1.5. Only base-pay entries count; other pay components on a batch are not counted.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On a card plan whose monthly cashback cap is, hypothetically, 55.00:

- Diamond shopper, 20 base-pay entries: cap of 55.00 multiplied by 1.5, which is 82.50;
- Diamond shopper, 19 base-pay entries: cap of 55.00;
- Platinum shopper, 15 base-pay entries: 55.00 multiplied by 1.25 is 68.75;
- Gold shopper, 30 base-pay entries: cap of 55.00.
